blocks.text: Unified Modeling Language (UML) software system ka design tasveer ki shakal mein dikhane ka ek standard tareeqa hai. Yeh developers ko samajhne mein madad deti hai ke system kaise kaam karta hai aur us ke hisse aapas mein kaise rabta (communicate) karte hain. UML is liye aham hai ke yeh complex systems ko samajhna aur sambhalna aasan banati hai.

blocks.title: Did You Know? (Kya aap jante hain?)
blocks.text: UML teen software engineers ne banai: Grady Booch, James Rumbaugh aur Ivar Jacobson. Inhein aksar UML ke "Three Amigos" (teen dost) kaha jata hai.

blocks.prompt: UML kis ne banai, aur yeh kyun aham hai?
blocks.explanation: Grady Booch, James Rumbaugh aur Ivar Jacobson ne. Yeh system ka design dikhane ka standard tasveeri tareeqa hai jis se complex system samajhna aur sambhalna aasan hota hai.

items: UML: software design dikhane ka standard tasveeri tareeqa; complex systems samajhna aur sambhalna aasan.
Banane wale: Booch, Rumbaugh, Jacobson ("Three Amigos").
